resources.string: Lets AppLock see which app you just opened, so it can ask for your fingerprint or PIN before a locked app appears. AppLock never reads screen contents.
Use your fingerprint, face or device PIN
Locked apps will ask for your fingerprint or PIN
Fallback mode — a locked app may flash briefly before the lock appears
AppLock can no longer tell which app you open, so your locked apps are opening freely. Tap to fix it.
